title: Business Object Population and Relationship Reconciliation
objective: Ensure Flora presents exactly the business objects supplied by the Twin and correctly associates Programmes and Opportunities with their Enterprises.
implementation_summary: Accepted candidate state is the reusable semantic business-object population boundary.
Immutable source/canonical IDs produce one executive entity per business object.
Enterprise dossiers and diagnostics share direction-neutral consumption of existing governed relationship records and canonical ownership.
expected_visible_outcomes: Opportunities shows 17 available and exactly 17 entities, with no supporting records rendered as Opportunities.
BT Group and all other Enterprise dossiers show only canonically owned or explicitly related Programmes and Opportunities, labelled with the governed relationship type.
Advanced Inspection shows business-object population and Enterprise association reconciliation.
Explore Twin and executive routes consume the same population owner.
unchanged_areas: Importer, validator, adapter, semantic construction, Canonical Factual Projection semantics, Observation runtime, owner assessment, Research Gaps logic, executive page semantics, TEL-001 fixture, governance and promotion remain unchanged by this operational acceptance panel.
TEL-001 package contents and checksum remain unchanged.
No automatic acceptance, promotion, recommendations or TEL-001-specific production logic is introduced.
required_test_steps: Open Opportunities and count the 17 data-business-object Opportunity entities.
Open Major Programmes and count the 13 data-business-object Programme entities.
Open BT Group and compare Programme and Opportunity IDs and relationship labels with Advanced Inspection.
Check all six Enterprise pages and confirm unrelated records are absent.
Open Advanced Inspection and confirm both reconciliation tables report PASS.
Open Explore Twin and confirm Opportunity count is 17.
fresh_import_policy: Fresh import is required only when the approved change is live and material runtime components that affect candidate representation changed before the candidate was imported. UI-only, presentation-only and diagnostics-only panel changes do not require reimport. If timestamps or component classification are unavailable, Flora reports Cannot determine rather than forcing a reimport.

automated_validation.known_failing_tests: None in focused population/relationship acceptance suite.

operator_validation_status: PASS — real TEL-001 routes rendered to repository acceptance artefacts
merge_mode: unverified until GitHub merge metadata or deployed change marker is available
fresh_import_required: No — ignored supporting rows and accepted business objects already persist; the corrected read boundary is applied at request time.
